{{Otheruses|Shadow Squadron}}
'''Shadow Squadron''' was one of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] assigned to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on his hunt for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].

Shadow Squadron worked with the rest of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group at the [[Battle of Selaggis|battle]] of [[Selaggis VI]], which included the X-wing squadrons of [[Corsair Squadron]], [[High Flight Squadron]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], [[Wraith Squadron]], the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] equipped [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]], and the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] equipped [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron]].

Shadow Squadron lost at least [[Shadow Twelve (New Republic)|Shadow Twelve]] and worked with [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]] reconnoitering Selaggis VI's moons looking for [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] before it was located by [[Polearm One]] [[Todra Mayn]], a Human from [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].
